description: A terminal side panel (svr) that sees every Claude Code session you have running, with a per-repository message board agents use to coordinate.
rules: Install with `brew install marijusaj/tap/savras` or `cargo install savras`; the binary is `svr`.
`svr --once` prints every Claude Code session as plain text and exits; use it from scripts and agents, never the interactive `svr`.
`svr board post "<message>"` and `svr board read` are how agents in the same repository talk; a board exists only where the owner ran `svr board create`, and agents must not create one.
Savras reads ~/.claude/jobs/*/state.json and never writes under ~/.claude/.
